title: Senior Manager, Credit Risk
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

As Senior Manager, Credit Risk, you’ll lead Airwallex’s global second-line oversight of credit, FX, and counterparty risk. You’ll set the guardrails that support responsible growth across merchant acquiring, charge cards, FX, treasury, settlement, and banking-partner activities.

- Lead Airwallex’s global second-line oversight of credit, FX, and counterparty risk, setting the guardrails that support responsible growth across merchant acquiring, charge cards, FX, treasury, settlement, and banking-partner activities.

- Own the global risk framework, risk appetite, limits, governance, and portfolio oversight across products and legal entities, providing independent challenge to first-line decisions and trusted advice to senior leaders.

- Oversee credit exposures and challenge underwriting strategies, customer and merchant risk policies, credit assessments, limit-setting methodologies, exception processes, and mitigation strategies.

- Establish and monitor second-line controls for FX and counterparty exposures, including pre-funding, settlement, customer activity, treasury flows, banking partners, payment partners, merchants, and customers.

- Lead proactive monitoring of portfolio trends and early-warning indicators, support risk committee decisions and material approvals, and represent Credit Risk in regulatory examinations, audits, and banking-partner reviews.

This role is based in Dallas, Texas and is fully remote.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

- 10-15 years of progressively senior experience across credit risk, counterparty risk, FX risk, treasury risk, or related financial risk disciplines within banking, payments, fintech, or another highly regulated financial services environment.

- Deep experience designing, implementing, and governing second-line credit risk frameworks in a complex, multi-jurisdictional organization.

- Strong understanding of credit risk identification, measurement, underwriting, limit management, monitoring, mitigation, provisioning, loss recognition, and capital implications.

- Demonstrated experience managing risk across multiple product lines, such as merchant acquiring, commercial or charge cards, B2B lending, payment processing, FX, treasury, settlement, or banking-partner activities.

- Practical experience overseeing FX and counterparty risk, including exposure measurement, concentration risk, limits, settlement risk, prefunding, collateral or other mitigants, and escalation governance.

- Proven ability to challenge first-line decisions and communicate clear risk positions to senior executives, commercial leaders, product and operations teams, banking partners, auditors, and regulators.

Preferred

- Advanced degree such as an MBA or Master's in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field.

- Professional certification such as FRM, PRM, CFA, or an equivalent qualification.

- Experience with automated decisioning engines, credit scori

Job Title: ​
Actuarial Manager, Medicare Value-Based Care
Job Description: ​
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

agilon health partners with primary care physicians to transform how care is delivered to seniors, taking on full-risk, total-cost-of-care arrangements. The actuarial team's work sits at the center of that model.
The Actuarial Manager, Medicare Value-Based Care is a senior individual contributor on the Markets actuarial team who will own the monthly results process for agilon's ACO REACH/ACO LEAD and MSSP populations, support payer settlement reconciliations, and produce supplemental exhibits for the month-end close. Operating in a consulting-style capacity, the Manager will also deliver high-priority analyses and project work, both individually and leading analysts from across the team, without direct people-management responsibility.

This role is ideal for an experienced actuary who enjoys variety: roughly 40% of time is dedicated to CMS value-based program results, 40% to ad hoc projects and analyst coaching, and the remaining 20% to annual payer financial settlement work and select MA close deliverables. The Manager will also help incorporate AI support into the team's processes and co-lead project management across the actuarial organization.
This is a fully remote position with minimal required trav el.

This newly established role reports to the Sr. Director for the Markets Actuarial team. The Markets team collaborates extensively with counterparts throughout the company, while peers on the Central team develop models, tools, and methodology. The role carries strong visibility with senior leaders across the organization, and the breadth of ownership is designed to build toward future leadership opportunities on the actuarial team.

Essential Job Functions:

• Value-Based Program Results (ACO REACH/LEAD and MSSP)

• Own the end-to-end monthly results process: coordinate membership and revenue data intake from partner teams, run the retrospective trend adjustment (RTA) model, and oversee claims reserving and projection process

• Guide the team through the CMS transition from ACO REACH to ACO LEAD: partner with the Central actuarial team (tools/methodology) on new requirements, and the VP of Direct Contracting on strategy

• Consolidate results into clear summaries and lead the monthly results presentation to the Regional CFOs on the Market Finance team
Payer Settlement Reconciliation

• Review payer contract terms to establish how final settlements should be calculated

• Reconcile payer settlement calculations against contract terms and underlying claims and revenue data; identify discrepancies and build the analytical case to challenge settlements that are not handled correctly, contributing to the team's annual savings targets

• Represent the finance organization directly with payer counterparts in a polished and professional manner to raise questions and request the detail needed for our review
Medicare Advantage Month-End Close Support

• Build and maintain supplemental close exhibits, such as schedules of revenue accrual assumptions and accrual amounts by payor and market

• Transform the actuarial team outputs into the required inputs for the FP&A team

• Quantify and present drivers of claims prior period development, separating natural month-over-month runout from methodology updates and other one-time considerations
Special Projects and Analyst Coaching

• Lead project intake, prioritization, and progress tracking across the actuarial team

• Lead high-priority ad hoc analyses end-to-end, flexing across markets and topics based on team needs

• Coach and mentor analysts through project work, providing technical direction and review to expand team capacity and enhance the quality of the work product

• Represent actuarial leadership in cross-functi

• 3+ years of commercial software development, at least 2 of them with Angular (2+) .

Nice-to-have:

• PHP - plugins and integrations (WordPress, hosting control panels).

• Go - services and CLI tools that run on customer servers.

• SQL - Postgres / SQLite / ClickHouse.

• Bash - deployment scripts and automation.

• Background in information security (antivirus, WAF, firewalls) or web hosting.

Benefits
What's in it for you?

• A focus on professional development.

• Interesting and challenging projects.

• Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.

• Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.

• Compensation for private medical insurance.

• Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.

• Budget for education.

• The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager
description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Machine Learning and AI Team 👋

Machine learning is at the heart of Trainline’s mission to help millions of people make sustainable travel choices every day. Our models and AI agents support customers when journeys go wrong, power search and recommendations across our apps and website, find the best fares through pricing and routing optimisation, personalise the experience with generative AI, and make our digital marketing smarter. Our teams own the full lifecycle from idea to production, and work closely with colleagues across the business to grow the impact of ML and AI at Trainline.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Manager to lead a team of 7 ML engineers and data engineers within our Core Experience pillar, which covers Search, Supply and Commerce. Your team’s work sits at the centre of how customers find, compare and buy their tickets. You’ll be accountable for what your team ships and how it ships it: the quality of the systems, the pace of delivery and the growth of the people building them. You’ll work alongside data scientists, software engineers and product managers. You’ll stay close enough to the technical work to make good calls on architecture, trade-offs and risk. What unites us is curiosity, a love of what we do and a desire to make sustainable travel the easy choice.

In this role, you will... 🚄

- Lead, coach and grow a team of ML and data engineers. That means setting clear expectations, giving regular feedback, managing performance and building an inclusive team where people do their best work

- Hire for the team, shaping the roles we need and running a fair, rigorous interview process

- Own delivery: plan and prioritise with your product partners across Search, Supply and Commerce, unblock the team, and ship ML and AI systems that move measurable customer and business outcomes

- Set the technical direction for your team’s systems, including architecture, build-versus-buy, and knowing when a simpler approach beats a more sophisticated one

- Make sure the team builds well across the whole lifecycle: reliable data pipelines, high-quality features, rigorous offline and online evaluation (including A/B testing), reliable deployment, monitoring and ongoing maintenance

- Lead the team in building production-grade agentic systems, using orchestration harnesses such as LangGraph to design multi-step workflows, tool use and human-in-the-loop controls

- Make evaluation a first-class engineering discipline for LLM and agent work. That means curated eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, tracing, regression testing of prompts and agents, and online monitoring of quality, cost and latency

- Set the guardrails for responsible use of AI, covering safety, privacy and clear fallbacks when an agent shouldn’t act on its own

- Raise the bar on engineering practice through code and design reviews, CI/CD, MLOps, observability and on-call

- Build strong relationships with senior leaders

title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.

Your Responsibilities

• You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.

• Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.

• Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.

• Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.

• Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.

• Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.

• Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.

• Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.

• Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Research Intern - Citizens Against Government Waste
tags: Part Time or Full Time Internship
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) offers a wide variety of opportunities to college students across the country. Unpaid research, communications, and government affairs internships are available on a year-round basis and can vary in length from a semester to a few weeks in duration. Interns can choose to work part-time or full-time, as hours of work are extremely flexible. Our daily work with Capitol Hill and the White House, as well as government agencies and other nonprofit organizations, provides a close and invaluable look at how Washington works. Since CAGW maintains a small staff, interns gain hands-on experience in all aspects of CAGW’s activities. Many projects involve working closely with staff members, while others require a great deal of independence. Interns are considered important members of our staff and actively participate in staff meetings and other events. While interns will also be required to perform clerical duties from time to time, much of the work will be substantive.
 
Research Internship
Assist in formulating policy papers and collect data for original investigative studies. Research and write for CAGW’s annual publications, which include the Congressional Pig Book, Prime Cuts, Government WasteWatch eNews, and special projects, including issue briefs, and policy papers. Interns will have the opportunity to initiate projects. Research internships are also available in specific areas, including healthcare and science, technology and telecommunications, federal regulations and taxation.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

title: VP, Marketplace Growth at DonorsChoose
description:
About DonorsChoose
DonorsChoose is an education nonprofit ensuring every US public school student has the classroom resources they need to learn, grow, and thrive.
Founded by a teacher in 2000, DonorsChoose connects educators with a nationwide community of supporters who believe investing in students today will transform tomorrow. Educators request the materials they know their students need, and donors can choose the classroom, community, or cause they want to support. Since our founding, donors have supported 90% of US public schools. Every request is vetted, resources are delivered to classrooms, and donors can see the impact of their support through transparent reporting and updates from students and teachers. Raising $1.9 billion for classrooms, DonorsChoose has earned top ratings from Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and CharityWatch for its transparency, trust, and impact. Our dedicated team works from across the United States to turn resources into opportunities for students and teachers.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence.

About You

Reliable builder: You design for failure and prove that recovery works.

Hands-on engineer: You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day.

Strong owner: You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support.

What you will be doing

• Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect.

What you will bring to the role

• Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language.

• Hands-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases.

• Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures.

• Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response.

• Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems.

Senior: Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation.

Staff: Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.

Principal: Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services.

Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

Minimum requirements for this role:

• 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role

• Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue

title: PRINCIPAL FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER (Alkira) (HOME, GB)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Alkira, a Lumen Connect Solution

One network. Every cloud. Total control, globally.

In this role, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor and hands-on deployment lead for Alkira’s strategic enterprise customers. Partnering with network, cloud, and platform teams, you will own the technical customer journey from initial evaluation and architecture design through production deployment, adoption, and expansion.

This is a highly customer-facing role that combines solutions architecture, cloud networking, automation, and technical consulting. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and internal Product and Engineering teams to deliver successful outcomes while providing field-based insights that help shape future product capabilities.

This is a remote role based in the UK, with the possibility of business travel if required.

The Main Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary technical owner for strategic customer engagements from evaluation through production deployment and ongoing adoption.

• Lead architecture discussions with customers and partners, providing guidance on networking, cloud connectivity, security, and infrastructure modernization.

• Design, build, and deploy Alkira-based solutions in customer environments using established best practices.

• Develop automation, integrations, and deployment tooling using Terraform, APIs, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.

• Partner directly with customer networking, cloud, and platform engineering teams to accelerate successful implementations.

• Deliver technical workshops, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, and enablement programs for customers and partners.

• Troubleshoot complex technical challenges and collaborate with Engineering teams to drive issue resolution and customer success.

• Collaborate with Product Management to provide customer feedback, influence roadmap priorities, and drive key feature requests through implementation.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, Professional Services Consultant, or Technical Advisor.

We are hiring the architect who teaches AI what our business actually means. You will be a member of the AI Domain team, the group that owns the enterprise standards, reference architectures, approved model catalog, and governance safeguards for AI across the company. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. Patterns here are proven through working proof-of-concepts before they become standards, so you will build as much as you write.

Requirements • We are hiring for domain modeling judgment and practical AI engineering. Deep expertise in both is rare; strength in one and fluency in the other works. • Eight or more years building production software, including time at staff, principal, or architect scope where other teams depended on what you owned • Practical experience designing ontologies, knowledge graphs, or canonical domain mod

We are seeking a detail-oriented and data-savvy QA Engineer to join our dynamic software development team. This role has an emphasis on validating data integrity, pipeline reliability, and complex analytical insights.

Our team builds a high-throughput analytics platform that processes massive datasets to deliver dashboards and metrics from diverse data streams for the emergency call handling space. • Write SQL queries to perform data reconciliation between source systems and the data warehouse/lake.

2. Analytics & Report Verification

• Test the business logic and mathematical correctness of aggregations, KPIs, and predictive metrics.

• Ensure that user-facing charts, graphs, and dashboards accurately reflect the underlying data.

• Conduct regression testing on analytics algorithms and reporting features to prevent data drift.

3. Test Automation & Infrastructure - Experience Advantageous

• Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for both APIs and UI dashboards.

• Implement automated data quality checks within the CI/CD pipeline.

• Mock large-scale datasets to simulate edge cases, high volume, and anomalous data.

• Evaluate how the analytics platform handles heavy concurrent user loads and massive data processing spikes.

• Monitor query performance and report latency bottlenecks to the engineering team.

5. Collaboration & Agile Processes

• Partner closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, and Report Developers to understand complex tracking requirements and data models.

• Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives to advocate for quality and testability early in the development lifecycle.

Basic Requirements
Required Technical Skills & Qualifications:

• Experience: 3+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, ideally within a data-intensive, BI, or analytics product environment.

• Database Proficiency: SQL skills (joins, window functions, subqueries) for deep-dive data verification.

• Automation Skills: Hands-on experience with automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and backend/API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured).

• Programming (Advantageous): Proficiency in at least one scripting language (preferably Python or JavaScript) for data manipulation and test automation.

• Data Technologies: Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and tools (e.g., Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and ETL pipelines.

• Methodology: Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development cycles and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).

• AI: AI use is encouraged and actively used to transform our technology stack.

Soft Skills & Cultural Fit

• The "Data Mindset": An obsessive attention to detail-you spot a misplaced decimal point or an omitted data row from a mile away.

• Analytical Thinker: Ability to understand complex business logic and translate it into edge-case test scenarios.

• Strong Communicator

title: Software Engineer, Traffic Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure behind OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and the API. Within Cloud Infrastructure, the Traffic team owns how traffic enters our cloud environments, moves between services, clusters, and regions, and reaches external dependencies.

Our work spans cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, ingress and egress gateways, proxies, load balancing, and traffic steering. We build the systems, controls, and observability that make these paths reliable, secure, efficient, and straightforward for other engineering teams to use.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll build and operate the networking and traffic infrastructure that connects OpenAI’s products and services across clouds and regions. The team’s work spans L3, L4, and L7-from IP connectivity, NAT, and transport behavior to service proxies and application request routing.

You’ll bring depth in part of this stack and curiosity about how the whole path works. Projects may include building gateways and control planes, improving cross-region connectivity, diagnosing packet loss or connection exhaustion, and making routing changes safer and easier to operate.

This role combines software engineering with production ownership. You’ll turn ambiguous networking problems into durable improvements, working closely with service owners, infrastructure teams, Security, and cloud providers.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA.

 

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Design, build, and operate ingress, egress, and service-to-service connectivity across clusters, regions, and clouds.

- Develop proxies, gateways, controllers, and automation for routing, load balancing, failover, and traffic management.

- Build and evolve cloud networking infrastructure, including private connectivity, NAT, and network isolation.

- Diagnose failures and performance bottlenecks across application, proxy, transport, and cloud networking layers; work with cloud providers when issues extend into their infrastructure.

- Build telemetry and diagnostic tools that explain traffic paths, identify failing components, and help engineers take effective action.

- Partner with Security to implement and validate traffic-path protections, including secure service communication, access controls, egress restrictions, and DDoS defenses.

- Improve latency, throughput, availability, and network efficiency through measurement, testing, and careful production rollouts.

- Create clear interfaces and safe defaults for service teams, participate in on-call, and turn operational lessons into changes that prevent recurring failures and reduce manual work.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have 5+ years of experience building production infrastructure or distributed systems, including substantial work on networking or traffic infrastructure.

- Have depth in one or more areas such as cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, proxies and gateways, service meshes, load balancing, or global traffic routing.

- Understand networking fundamentals and can reason about how IP routing, TCP/UDP, DNS, NAT, TLS, and HTTP/gRPC affect connectivity and performance.

- Have hands-on experience building or operating systems such as Envoy, NGINX, Istio, Cilium, or comparable networking infrastructure.

- Write production software in Go, Rust, C++, Python, or a similar language, and use software and automation to solve operational problems.

- Can investigate unfamiliar failures using evidence, test hypotheses, and follow problems through to a verified resolution.

- Take ownership of design, implementation, rollout, and ongoing reliability, and communicate clearly across teams when a problem crosses ownership boundaries.

- Care about making infrastructure secure and understandable for the engineers who depend on it.

We value deep expertise and the willingness to learn across boundaries. You do not need prior experience with every technology or networking lay

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own major parts of Radiant's AI cloud platform, joining one of five teams: Infra, Cluster, Observability, MLOps Training, or MLOps Inference. We'll match you to the team that fits your experience.

You'll design, build, and run distributed services at datacentre scale, working closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, and the other engineering teams.

The teams

- Infra: the core infrastructure our AI cloud runs on, from datacentre to platform

- Cluster: provisioning and operating the GPU clusters customers run their workloads on

- Observability: FlightDeck, the platform customers and operators use to observe and operate AI infrastructure

- MLOps Training: the platform customers use to run large-scale model training

- MLOps Inference: the platform customers use to serve models in production

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, build, and operate distributed services for your team's part of the platform.

- Own features from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

- Translate product requirements into clear technical designs and APIs.

- Improve testing, reliability, and performance across your services.

- Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems you build.

- Mentor engineers and contribute to design and code review.

 

YOUR PROFILE

- Solid experience building and running production software, ideally distributed systems.

- Strong hands-on engineering skills in Go or similar.

- Depth in at least one of: infrastructure, cluster management, observability, or MLOps (training or inference).

- Comfortable working in Linux and with Kubernetes and containers.

- Clear communicator who takes ownership of their work.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

- Domain depth: Bring real expertise in your team's area, and keep building it.

- Engineering quality: Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and review others' work with care.

- Ownership: Take features from design through production, and stay accountable for how they run.

- Pragmatism: Ship what matters, simply, and improve it from real-world feedback.

- Collaboration: Work openly with product, infrastructure, SRE and customers, and share what you learn.

 

QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR:

- Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

- Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

- You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

- 25 days of annual leave

- A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

- Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

- Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

- Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

- Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

- Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

- Participation in the company shares program

- Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two engineers) → Final.

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

title: Creative Marketing Designer
description:
Job description:
Company: Designial
Location: Remote/Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune, Maharashtra
Department: Marketing
Reports to: CEO and COO
About Designial

Designial is a results-driven digital marketing agency and HubSpot Solutions Partner headquartered in Silicon Valley . We are expanding our global operations and are excited to launch our new India office, based in Pune . We specialize in helping US-based businesses scale by leveraging the full power of the HubSpot platform.
Position Overview
Position Overview We are seeking a talented Creative Marketing Designer with a strong eye for visual storytelling and conversion. This role is focused on static and motion design-creating high-quality visuals for digital ads, social media, emails, and landing pages.
You will work directly with our leadership to interpret marketing goals and turn them into compelling visual assets. If you are a designer who understands layout, typography, and how to design for marketing results, this is the role for you.
Key Responsibilities

• Ad Creative & Social Media: Design eye-catching static visuals for LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram ads that stop the scroll and drive clicks.

• Marketing Collateral: Create high-quality assets for email marketing campaigns, eBooks, whitepapers, and sales presentations.

• Web & Landing Pages: Design visual elements and layouts for high-converting landing pages and website banners.

• Motion Graphics: Create engaging motion graphics and animations for social media, digital ads, and web content using the Adobe Creative Suite .

• Performance-Informed Design: Collaborate with the marketing team to analyze the performance of creative assets, using data and A/B testing results to iterate on and improve future designs.

• Brand Stewardship: Maintain and enforce our brand's visual identity, ensuring a high standard of creative excellence across all static and animated materials.

Qualifications and Experience

• Experience: 2-5 years of professional experience in graphic design, preferably in an agency or marketing team.

• Proven Track Record: You must provide a portfolio of case studies that clearly demonstrate how your design work has achieved measurable marketing outcomes. Examples include:

• Increased Conversion Rates: Landing pages or ads you designed that resulted in a quantifiable lift in conversions.

• Improved Engagement: Social media graphics or videos that led to a significant increase in engagement metrics (CTR, shares, comments).

• A/B Testing Wins: Examples of creative A/B tests you designed where your variant produced a statistically significant improvement.

• Creative Software Proficiency: Expert proficiency across the Adobe Creative Suite , with a strong emphasis on creating both static designs (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and compelling motion graphics.

• Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate marketing objectives into compelling creative and use data to inform design decisions.

• Strong Foundation: Excellent understanding of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy.

• Portfolio: A link to an online portfolio showcasing marketing designs (ads, social posts, brochures, etc.) is required .

• Communication: Excellent English communication skills are required for collaborating with US teams.

Bonus Points For

• Basic video editing or motion graphics skills (Canva, After Effects, or Premiere) are a plus, but not required.

• Experience with marketing automation platforms like HubSpot for creating and optimizing email and landing page designs.

• Familiarity with Figma for rapid prototyping and collaboration.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary based on experience.

• Opportunity to work with US clients and a Silicon Valley HQ.

• A flexible, remote-first work environment (Pune-based candidates preferred).

• Growth opportunities to move into a leadership role.

• A mature and professional environment that respects deep expertise and autonomy.

description:
About ClearGov

ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.

We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities.

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov , and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

Our Core Values

•
Be Clear & Credible
• We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage.

•
Be Human
• We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.

•
Be Better Together
• We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.

•
Be Honourable/Honorable
• We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.

•
Be Connected
• We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• You take ownership and follow through

• You communicate clearly and effectively

• You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out

• You learn quickly and adapt as things change

• You care about the team, not just your own work

• You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity
We’re looking for a Manager, Growth & Customer Marketing to lead a team of two and own ClearGov ’s full-funnel growth motion - from a prospect’s first touch through expansion revenue with existing customers. You’ll manage and develop a team of two: one teammate focused on inbound (SEO/AEO) and net-new ABM/ABX campaigns, the other on customer marketing for cross-sell and upsell. You inherit both with real runway to grow in scope and title as the team’s results build.
This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the strategy, coach your team, and own the numbers - while staying hands-on with the highest-leverage campaigns and content yourself.
We need someone who is AI-forward by default: you use AI tools to move faster on content, targeting, SEO/AEO research, and reporting as a matter of course, and you build that habit into how your team works, not just how you work. You’re proactive - you spot the SEO gap, the underperforming segment, or the expansion signal in the data before anyone points it out, and you act on it.

Team Leadership

• Hire (as needed), coach, and manage a team of 2 marketers - one owning acquisition (inbound/SEO/AEO, ABM/ABX), one owning customer marketing (cross-sell/upsell) - with regular 1:1s, clear goals, and a development plan that gives each a real path to grow.

• Set quarterly growth marketing strategy and OKRs spanning net-new pipeline and expansion revenue; report results to marketing leadership.

• Operate as a player-coach: personally lead ClearGov ’s highest-priority campaigns and strategic accounts while delegating day-to-day execution to your team.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights.

Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Booking.com, Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more .

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

Riskified's Legal team is looking for a Tel Aviv based Legal Counsel to join the team. In this role, you will be responsible for handling a variety of legal issues, focusing on  employment and litigation, with opportunities in many other areas, such as commercial, privacy, AI regulatory, and others, , supporting all of Riskified’s locations globally. This is a hands-on role, combining strategic advice with day-to-day operational work. This is an exciting opportunity to join a successful public tech company and assist management in taking risk-based decisions. Our company is seeking a candidate who is highly motivated, focused on making a significant impact on the business, and who can succeed in a cross-functional environment.

What You'll Be Doing

• Provide advice and strategic support to the HR team on a range of employment law issues across multiple jurisdictions, including those relating to recruiting, terminations, performance management, compensation and benefits, accommodations, leaves of absence, diversity programs, employee classification, immigration and other employment-related matters

• Assist with developing best practice processes and playbooks and manage templates’ updates to maintain compliance with employment laws and regulations

• Support Go To Market needs, including everything related to growth and legal advice on employment in different sites

• Support cross-organizational projects pertinent to employment

• Assist in employment-privacy interactions and commercial agreements with vendors supporting our HR team

• Lead  litigation and pre-litigation matters

 

Qualifications

• Law Degree Required

• Licensed to practice in Israel

• 2-5 years of relevant experience with a focus on employment law, including the laws of Israel, the United States, EMEA, LATAM and APAC.

• Practical mindset towards protecting the company from risks while enabling fast-paced growth and innovation

• Hands-on approach, with a willingness to take on both high-level and day-to-day operational work

• Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively

• English speaker with superb written and verbal communication skills

• Prior in-house experience at a global tech company is preferred

• International experience is a plus

Life at Riskified

We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking. We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.

Our Tel-Aviv team is currently working in a hybrid of remote and in-office work. We have recently moved to our new space in Tel Aviv - check it out here ! 

Some of our Tel Aviv Benefits & Perks:

• Equity for all employees, Keren Hishtalmut, pension

• Private medical insurance, e xtra time off for parents and caregivers

• Commuter and parking benefits

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. - Demonstrated ability to build and scale a function or team, ideally in a high-growth, technology, or innovation-oriented environment.

- Deep interest in legal technology and AI, with enough product aptitude to guide Legal Engineers and Legal Engineering Product Specialists on demos, workflow design, and customer enablement.

- Professional fluency in Japanese and English, with the ability to manage a bilingual team and engage credibly with senior stakeholders in both languages.

What You’ll Bring

•

•

•
Consistent Achiever: A proven history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas in competitive markets.

•
Independent & Adaptable: Self-motivated and well organized, able to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-changing environment.

•
Platform Proficiency: Familiarity with location analytics platforms and data visualization tools

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Capco is a global business and technology consultancy dedicated to the financial services industry. We combine deep industry expertise with consulting and technology capabilities to help leading financial institutions solve complex challenges and deliver meaningful transformation.

Across APAC and globally, we partner with banks and financial institutions on initiatives spanning digital transformation, technology modernisation, product innovation and large-scale change delivery.

As we continue to grow our Malaysia practice, we are looking for experienced design professionals who can help shape intuitive, engaging and user-centric digital experiences for our financial services clients.

We are looking for experienced Senior UI/UX Designers to lead the design of innovative digital products and experiences within the Wealth Management and Financial Services space.

You will play a key role in transforming complex business requirements, digital capabilities and emerging technologies into simple, intuitive and engaging user experiences across web and mobile platforms.

title: Technical Analyst Relations Manager
description:
Keeper Security is hiring a Technical Analyst Relations Manager to join our Global Communications team. This individual will own and execute the analyst relations program at Keeper while serving as a technical subject-matter expert on Keeper’s cybersecurity solutions. The role will manage analyst evaluations, briefings, timelines, coordination and internal workflows while ensuring Keeper’s technical capabilities, architecture, roadmap and market differentiation are accurately represented. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago. 

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help shape the product's go-to-market strategy, create compelling messaging and positioning, launch new features and enable the revenue team.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Role

Keeper Security is seeking a Technical Analyst Relations Manager to own and execute the Analyst Relations program while serving as a credible technical representative for Keeper. This role will manage analyst evaluations, briefings, questionnaires, calendars, internal reviews and follow-through, while also developing the technical narratives needed to explain Keeper’s cybersecurity platform, architecture, security model, use cases and competitive differentiation.

This role is well-suited for a candidate with experience in analyst relations, technical product marketing, product management, solutions marketing, sales engineering or a related technical function within the cybersecurity or enterprise technology industry. Success requires strong program management skills, deep technical curiosity and the ability to confidently engage with analysts and internal stakeholders on complex cybersecurity topics.

Responsibilities

• Own the operational and technical execution of Keeper’s Analyst Relations program, including timelines, workflows, documentation and stakeholder coordination

• Represent Keeper’s technical capabilities and cybersecurity differentiation clearly and credibly during analyst briefings, inquiries and evaluations

• Manage analyst evaluation processes, including Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, MarketScape and other cybersecurity research reports

• Develop and coordinate execution of technical questionnaires, written responses, briefing materials and product demonstrations

• Partner with Product, Marketing, PR and leadership to gather accurate information on Keeper’s product capabilities, architecture, integrations, security controls and roadmap

• Maintain analyst calendars, briefing schedules, biweekly check-ins and long-range planning for key firms and coverage areas

• Prepare internal subject-matter experts for analyst engagements and ensure technical responses are accurate, consistent and aligned with Keeper’s positioning

• Translate complex cybersecurity concepts, product functionality and technical use cases into clear narratives for analyst and executive audiences
